shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在仪器设备间门口，身后是一排仪器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a shared instrument room with rows of lab instruments behind it, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 第十章开讲：机械与设备安全。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向空白的设备清单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank equipment list board on the wall.
shots.narration: 第一课，先把仪器设备管起来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰来到共用仪器前，登记本上一位没写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a shared benchtop instrument and finds the usage logbook beside it left blank by the previous user.
shots.narration: 阿杰来用共用仪器，上一位没登记。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 仪器冒出一缕烟，阿杰皱眉闻到焦味
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin wisp of smoke rising from the back of the instrument and a student wrinkling his nose. No text.
shots.narration: 开机就闻到焦糊味，机器上却没挂牌。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师赶来关机拔插头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hurries in, switches off the instrument and pulls out the plug.
shots.narration: 王老师：设备也要有人管、按规矩用。

shots.section_title: 设备里关着危险能量
shots.scene: 仪器外壳里画着旋转、高温、电、化学四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed instrument housing with four icons inside, a spinning rotor, a heat wave, a lightning bolt and a chemical flask. No text.
shots.narration: 设备里关着转动、高温、电和化学能。

shots.section_title: 设备里关着危险能量
shots.scene: 外壳裂开，能量冲出来，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked housing with energy bursting out toward a person, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 防护一失效，这些能量就会伤人。

shots.section_title: 设备里关着危险能量
shots.scene: 阿杰对着仪器认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the instrument seriously and nods with respect.
shots.narration: 对设备，要心存敬畏。

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 生命周期环：采购、验收、使用、维护、报废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circular life cycle with five icons, a purchase order, an inspection tick, an operator, a wrench and a recycling bin. No text.
shots.narration: 设备从买进到报废，每一步都要管。
overlay: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 采购单上的合格标志，安装后检测验收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a purchase form with a quality mark icon, then a technician testing a newly installed instrument and ticking an acceptance sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 选合格产品，安装检测验收后再用。

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 老李对照装箱单清点到货
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a delivered instrument against a blank packing list, ticking items one by one.
shots.narration: 到货对照装箱单，一样一样点清。

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 资产登记、设备档案、说明书放在设备旁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an asset register, an equipment file folder and a manual placed in a holder beside the instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 登记资产，建档案，说明书放旁边。

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 改装设备要走审批流程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a modified instrument part with an approval form and a signature before the change. No text.
shots.narration: 换零件、改设备，要走变更审批。

shots.section_title: 全生命周期管理：从验收建档到报废
shots.scene: 报废前清洁去污，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old instrument being wiped and decontaminated, then a blank disposal label attached before removal. No text.
shots.narration: 报废前先清洁去污，按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 先读说明书和操作规程
shots.scene: 小研翻开新仪器的说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the manual of a new instrument and reads it carefully at the bench.
shots.narration: 用新设备前，先读说明书。
overlay: 先读说明书和操作规程

shots.section_title: 先读说明书和操作规程
shots.scene: 说明书上适用范围、限制条件、警示三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons on a manual page, a range scale, a limit stop symbol and a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 看清适用范围、限制条件和警示。

shots.section_title: 先读说明书和操作规程
shots.scene: 仪器旁墙上挂着空白操作规程卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank operating procedure card mounted on the wall beside the instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 按操作规程一步步来。

shots.section_title: 培训考核，授权上机
shots.scene: 王老师给新人讲开关机和日常维护
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains two new students on how to switch an instrument on and off and do daily care.
shots.narration: 新设备、新人员，先培训。

shots.section_title: 培训考核，授权上机
shots.scene: 考核通过，空白授权名单上打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a passed practical test with a tick, then a new tick on a blank authorised user list. No text.
shots.narration: 考核通过，获得授权才能独立使用。

shots.section_title: 培训考核，授权上机
shots.scene: 学会一台不等于会用另一台
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student authorised for one instrument walking toward a different instrument, a training icon in between. No text.
shots.narration: 想用别的设备，再参加它的培训。

shots.section_title: 培训考核，授权上机
shots.scene: 光小心不够，没授权打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a careful looking person reaching for a power tool without an authorisation card, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 光小心不够，要培训授权。

shots.section_title: 预约用本人账号，按规定选时段
shots.scene: 电脑上的设备预约页面，绿色空闲格
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an equipment booking page on a computer screen with blank green free slots and grey booked slots. No text.
shots.narration: 在本校平台上预约设备。
overlay: 预约用本人账号，按规定选时段

shots.section_title: 预约用本人账号，按规定选时段
shots.scene: 时段长度、每天时长、提前天数三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a slot length clock, a daily limit bar and a calendar with days ahead. No text.
shots.narration: 时段长短、提前几天，按本校规定。

shots.section_title: 预约用本人账号，按规定选时段
shots.scene: 本人账号登录，借用别人账号打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student logging in with his own account, and a borrowed account card from a classmate crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用本人账号预约，不借别人账号。

shots.section_title: 使用登记、清洁交接，运行有人看
shots.scene: 阿杰在使用登记本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a usage logbook beside the instrument before starting.
shots.narration: 用前登记，看上一位有没有异常。
overlay: 使用登记、清洁交接，运行有人看

shots.section_title: 使用登记、清洁交接，运行有人看
shots.scene: 用后清空、擦拭消毒，器材清点归位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an instrument emptied and wiped clean after use, tools counted and returned to their places. No text.
shots.narration: 用后清空清洁，器材清点归位。

shots.section_title: 使用登记、清洁交接，运行有人看
shots.scene: 耗材领用登记表：日期、数量、领用人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a consumables issue log with three blank columns and a box of spare nozzles. No text.
shots.narration: 耗材领用，也要登记。

shots.section_title: 使用登记、清洁交接，运行有人看
shots.scene: 运行中人在旁边，过夜运行有审批单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person staying beside a running instrument, and an overnight run with an approval form and a contact card. No text.
shots.narration: 运行中别走开，过夜运行要经批准。

shots.section_title: 放稳擦净，定期维护和检查
shots.scene: 仪器放平放稳，四周留散热空间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an instrument placed level and steady on a bench with clear space around it for ventilation. No text.
shots.narration: 设备放稳，周围留出散热空间。
overlay: 放稳擦净，定期维护和检查

shots.section_title: 放稳擦净，定期维护和检查
shots.scene: 按清单逐项检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a technician going through a blank inspection checklist item by item in front of an instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查，按清单一项项过。

shots.section_title: 放稳擦净，定期维护和检查
shots.scene: 老李按维护计划保养，记入台账
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer services an instrument according to a maintenance plan and records it in a ledger.
shots.narration: 维护按计划，检修交给专业人员。

shots.section_title: 认准检定校准标识，合格才用
shots.scene: 【实拍】仪器上的计量检定/校准合格标识特写（遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a calibration status label on the side of a lab instrument and a fingertip pointing to its due date area.
shots.narration: 看清检定校准标识，在有效期内。
overlay: 认准检定校准标识，合格才用

shots.section_title: 认准检定校准标识，合格才用
shots.scene: 标识过期，仪器停用送检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an expired calibration label, the instrument tagged out of use and sent for testing. No text.
shots.narration: 过期或没有标识，停用送检。

shots.section_title: 认准检定校准标识，合格才用
shots.scene: 校准关系数据，也关系安全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance scale with a data chart on one side and a safety shield on the other, level. No text.
shots.narration: 重视数据准确，更要重视安全。

shots.section_title: 异响异味报警，立即停机
shots.scene: 异响、异味、冒烟、报警四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons around an instrument, a sound wave, a nose, smoke and an alarm bell. No text.
shots.narration: 异响、异味、冒烟、报警，立即停机。
overlay: 异响异味报警，立即停机

shots.section_title: 异响异味报警，立即停机
shots.scene: 密封圈破损，人停下手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged rubber seal ring on an instrument lid, the operator stopping work at once. No text.
shots.narration: 密封圈、垫片坏了，停工报告。

shots.section_title: 异响异味报警，立即停机
shots.scene: 电机嗡嗡响不转、外壳发烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor humming but not turning, the casing hot with heat waves, a hand switching off the power. No text.
shots.narration: 嗡嗡响不转、发烫，马上断电。

shots.section_title: 异响异味报警，立即停机
shots.scene: 屏幕花屏黑屏，停止手势
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a control screen flickering with distorted bars, a stop hand symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 屏幕花屏、黑屏，也要停用。

shots.section_title: 异响异味报警，立即停机
shots.scene: 运行中报错，先暂停等停稳，手伸进打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an automatic instrument showing an error, a finger pressing pause and waiting, a hand reaching into moving parts crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 报错先暂停，停稳前不伸手。

shots.section_title: 故障挂牌停用，报修不私修
shots.scene: 拔插头，挂空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power plug pulled out and a blank out of service tag hung on the instrument. No text.
shots.narration: 故障先断电，挂上停用标识。
overlay: 故障挂牌停用，报修不私修

shots.section_title: 故障挂牌停用，报修不私修
shots.scene: 【实拍】把填好的故障停用牌挂在已断电的仪器上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand hanging a filled in out of service tag on the front of a switched off lab instrument.
shots.narration: 停用牌提醒别人，别留给下一组。

shots.section_title: 故障挂牌停用，报修不私修
shots.scene: 使用记录登记故障，报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fault written in the usage record and a phone call to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 登记故障，报告负责人报修。

shots.section_title: 故障挂牌停用，报修不私修
shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀拆仪器，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student opening an instrument housing with a screwdriver, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不私自拆修，等修好验收再用。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器的特殊警示：核磁强磁场
shots.scene: 核磁共振仪和磁力线示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large superconducting magnet instrument with invisible magnetic field lines spreading around it. No text.
shots.narration: 核磁的磁体一直有磁，不能关。
overlay: 大型仪器的特殊警示：核磁强磁场

shots.section_title: 大型仪器的特殊警示：核磁强磁场
shots.scene: 【实拍】核磁共振室地面警戒线和门口当心磁场标志（不进入警戒线）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a marked boundary line on the floor around a magnet room and a magnetic field warning sign at the door.
shots.narration: 地上的警戒线，就是安全边界。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器的特殊警示：核磁强磁场
shots.scene: 扳手越线被吸飞，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an iron wrench crossing the floor line and flying toward the magnet, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 铁制工具越线，会被吸成飞弹。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器的特殊警示：核磁强磁场
shots.scene: 进门前放下钥匙、手机、磁卡，起搏器人员禁入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: keys, a phone and a magnetic card left in a tray at the door, and a heart pacemaker icon with a no entry symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 先放下铁磁物品，植入起搏器者不进。

shots.section_title: 别让设备给你假安全感
shots.scene: 仪器外壳像盾牌，人站在后面松懈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an instrument drawn like a shield and a relaxed person leaning on it, a question mark above. No text.
shots.narration: 好设备，不等于不会出事。
overlay: 别让设备给你假安全感

shots.section_title: 别让设备给你假安全感
shots.scene: 检查标签有效、离心机配平两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a label with a valid date and a balanced centrifuge rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 看看标签有效吗？离心机配平了吗？

shots.section_title: 别让设备给你假安全感
shots.scene: 阿杰擦拭仪器，仪器伸出保护手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes an instrument carefully, and the instrument is drawn with a small protective glow around him.
shots.narration: 爱护设备，设备也会保护你。

shots.section_title: 特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 压力容器、气瓶、起重机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a pressure vessel, a gas cylinder and a small crane. No text.
shots.narration: 压力容器、气瓶等，属于特种设备。
overlay: 特种设备：登记、检验、持证

shots.section_title: 特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 使用登记证、定期检验合格标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank registration certificate and an inspection label on a pressure vessel, a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 依法登记，按期检验，合格才用。

shots.section_title: 特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 持证人员操作，无证打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a certified operator with a blank certificate card using a pressure vessel, and a person without a card crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定需要持证的，持证操作。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 生命周期环、授权卡、登记本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a life cycle ring, an authorisation card and a usage logbook. No text.
shots.narration: 全程建档，授权上机，用前用后登记。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 校准标识、维护扳手、停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a calibration label, a maintenance wrench and an out of service tag. No text.
shots.narration: 标识有效，按时维护，故障挂牌。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 核磁警戒线和特种设备检验标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnet room floor line and an inspection label on a pressure vessel. No text.
shots.narration: 特殊设备特殊警示，特种设备依法管。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台盖好的离心机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed benchtop centrifuge and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：离心机的安全使用。
